title: Detailed planet with rings
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Planet body base -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='24' fill='#4A7BC8'/>
  <!-- Atmosphere glow -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='25.5' fill='none' stroke='#7EC8E3' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Surface bands -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='21' ry='5' fill='#6A9BD8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='22' ry='6' fill='#3A6AA8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='18' ry='3.5' fill='#8AB8E8' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='16' ry='3' fill='#2E5A8A' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Storm spot -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='48' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#D4E8F8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='48' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#A8CCE8' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- Small storms -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='58' r='2' fill='#9AC8E8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#CCEEFF' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Planet highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='42' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#A8D4F0' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- Ring back (behind planet) -->
  <path d='M 10 38 Q 50 18 90 38' fill='none' stroke='#E8B84A' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M 8 35 Q 50 12 92 35' fill='none' stroke='#F4D03F' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- Ring front (in front of planet) -->
  <path d='M 10 42 Q 50 82 90 42' fill='none' stroke='#E8B84A' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M 8 45 Q 50 88 92 45' fill='none' stroke='#F4D03F' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M 12 40 Q 50 78 88 40' fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Ring inner line -->
  <path d='M 14 44 Q 50 72 86 44' fill='none' stroke='#C89830' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Ring gap -->
  <path d='M 12 43 Q 50 76 88 43' fill='none' stroke='#1A1A3A' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Ring particle details -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='70' r='0.8' fill='#FFE88A' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='77' r='0.7' fill='#FFE88A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='79' r='0.9' fill='#FFE88A' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='77' r='0.7' fill='#FFE88A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='70' r='0.8' fill='#FFE88A' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Stars -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='15' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='12' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='68' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='62' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='88' r='0.7' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='90' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='30' r='0.6' fill='#CCDDFF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='25' r='0.7' fill='#CCDDFF' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='5' cy='48' r='0.6' fill='#CCDDFF' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='95' cy='52' r='0.7' fill='#CCDDFF' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
